translations.web: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
translations.bsb: So Jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother, who made the tasty food his father loved.
translations.kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
translations.asv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother. And his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
